title: SECRET PLACE OF GOD
PSALM 91 PROTECTION
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: If lingering fear about tomorrow is keeping your mind awake tonight, stay and pray.
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
I will say of the LORD, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
Father, cover this weary heart right now with Your unseen presence and quiet mercy.
Surround every thought with divine peace, shield this home from all harm, and grant rest.
You alone are the sure fortress when everything else trembles.
Subscribe to The Covenant Shield and walk daily under God's covering.
